Gladiator Beast Laquari.name: Gladiator Beast Laquari
effects: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of a 'Gladiator Beast' monster, its original ATK becomes 2100. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 'Gladiator Beast' monster from your Deck, except 'Gladiator Beast Laquari'.

Gladiator Beast Attorix.name: Gladiator Beast Attorix
effects: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a 'Gladiator Beast' monster: You can send 1 'Gladiator Beast' monster from your Deck or Extra Deck to the GY, except 'Gladiator Beast Attorix'; until the End Phase, this card's Level and name become the same as that monster's.

Gladiator Beast Bestiari.name: Gladiator Beast Bestiari
effects: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a 'Gladiator Beast' monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

Gladiator Beast Vespasius.name: Gladiator Beast Vespasius
effects: At the start of the Damage Step, if your 'Gladiator Beast' monster battles a monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.

Gladiator Beast Gyzarus.name: Gladiator Beast Gyzarus
effects: 'Gladiator Beast Bestiari' + 1 'Gladiator Beast' monster. Must first be Special Summoned by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. When this card is Special Summoned: Target up to 2 cards on the field; destroy those targets.

Gladiator Proving Ground.name: Gladiator Proving Ground
effects: Add 1 Level 4 or lower 'Gladiator Beast' monster from your Deck to your hand.

Gladiator Beast United.name: Gladiator Beast United
effects: During the Main or Battle Phase: Shuffle into the Deck from your hand, field, or GY the Fusion Materials listed on a 'Gladiator Beast' Fusion Monster, then Special Summon that Fusion Monster.

Gladiator Beast War Chariot.name: Gladiator Beast War Chariot
effects: When a monster effect is activated, while you control a 'Gladiator Beast' monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Monster Reborn.name: Monster Reborn
effects: Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it.

Raigeki.name: Raigeki
effects: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
